title: View product catalog with six items
preconditions: User is logged in with standard_user
steps:
1. Open https://www.saucedemo.com/
2. Login with standard_user / secret_sauce
3. Land on inventory page

title: Each product shows name price and image
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
steps:
1. Inspect every product card
2. Check product name element
3. Check product price element
4. Check product image element
expected_result: Each of the 6 products has a visible name price and image

title: Add to cart button available for every product
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
steps:
1. Inspect every product card
2. Verify Add to cart button presence
expected_result: Add to cart button is available on each of the 6 products

title: Sort products by price low to high
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
steps:
1. Select sort option Price (low to high)
2. Observe product order
expected_result: Products are ordered by ascending price (cheapest first)

title: Sort products by price high to low
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
steps:
1. Select sort option Price (high to low)
2. Observe product order
expected_result: Products are ordered by descending price (most expensive first)

title: Catalog does not load without login
preconditions: User is on login page and not authenticated
expected_result: User is redirected to login page and no product catalog is shown

title: Product count is not empty
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
expected_result: Product count is not 0 and equals 6

title: No Add to cart button on empty catalog state
preconditions: User is logged in with a drained catalog (mocked)
steps:
1. Force empty inventory state
2. Observe product area
expected_result: No Add to cart buttons are rendered when catalog is empty

title: Sort remains consistent with corrupt price data
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page with mocked corrupt price
steps:
1. Force one product price to be non-numeric
2. Select sort option
expected_result: Sorting does not crash and corrupt item is handled gracefully

title: Image does not render for broken image
preconditions: User is logged in with problem_user
steps:
1. Open inventory page
2. Inspect product images
expected_result: Broken image is detected and reported (image not blank)

title: Sort with identical prices keeps stable order
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
steps:
1. Mock two products with identical price
2. Sort by price
3. Observe their relative order
expected_result: Products with equal price keep a stable deterministic order

title: Sort selection persists after page refresh
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
steps:
1. Select sort option Price (high to low)
2. Refresh page
3. Observe sort dropdown
expected_result: Selected sort option is preserved after refresh

title: First and last item are min and max after sort
preconditions: User is logged in and on inventory page
steps:
1. Sort by Price (low to high)
2. Compare first and last product price
expected_result: First product has minimum price and last product has maximum price

title: Catalog loads under slow account
preconditions: User is logged in with performance_glitch_user
steps:
1. Open inventory page
2. Wait for products to load
expected_result: Catalog eventually loads all 6 products despite delayed rendering
